name: Mpox
value: Clade Ib community spread in 9 European states
summary: WHO lists clade Ib community transmission in nine European countries; no new mpox emergency declared
state: WHO's situation report of 14 Sep, its latest found, lists community transmission of clade Ib in Czechia, France, Germany, Ireland, Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Switzerland and the UK, and treats mpox as a graded emergency with standing recommendations to August 2027 (WHO). South Africa had 26 confirmed cases to 27 Oct, 19 of them clade Ib (Daily Maverick, 3 Nov). Searches on 17 Nov found no new emergency of international concern, so clade I spread outside Africa keeps Watch.
for_you: Most people's risk is low. Close skin-to-skin or sexual contact carries the main risk. UKHSA guidance covers symptoms, testing and vaccine eligibility for those at higher risk; travellers can check NHS and FCDO advice for affected countries.
